gameDescriptionHtml:
Prepare to enter a world of epic battles, diverse characters, and an endless flow of action in Call of Sentinels! This fast-paced bullet hell arena shooter will test your reflexes and strategic skills as you fight your way through hordes of enemies and powerful bosses. Think of it like a fusion of Hades’ strategic depth and Crimsonland’s frenetic combat, but with a Vampire Survivors twist that lets you unleash a whirlwind of abilities and customize your build to an extreme.

Game Features

  • Diverse Builds – Call of Sentinels features a diverse roster of heroes and weapons, each with unique abilities and playstyles. Experiment with different builds to find the one that suits you best and become a force to be reckoned with on the battlefield. Think Vampire Survivors but with more depth and strategic choices as you build your ultimate hero.
  • Powerful Bosses – Prepare to face off against challenging bosses, each with their own unique mechanics and attacks. Outsmart them, dodge their devastating blows, and emerge victorious! Just like Hades, you’ll need to master their patterns and exploit their weaknesses to survive.
  • Epic Characters and Weapons – Unleash the power of a stunning arsenal of weapons and equip yourself with unique characters that bring their own flavor to the battlefield. From powerful magic users to agile warriors, choose your champion and dominate the arena! Feel the rush of Crimsonland’s combat but with a greater variety of character choices and abilities.
  • Story Mode – Embark on an epic journey through six beautifully crafted locations, each connected by a compelling story told through cutscenes and in-game dialogue. Unlock new characters, weapons, and unlock the path to the Infinite Arena!
  • Trials of Sentinels – During your battles, you’ll encounter special Trials of Sentinels – challenging tasks that, once completed, will give you the opportunity to choose from a variety of additional upgrades, further expanding your build possibilities! The thrill of the challenge combined with the reward of new options makes for a truly engaging and rewarding gameplay loop.
  • Hundreds of Skills – Master hundreds of skills and unlock powerful upgrades to craft your own unique build. Experiment with different combinations and build your character to dominate the battlefield! Like Vampire Survivors, you’ll have an endless array of upgrades and power-ups to choose from, but with more strategic depth and control.
